source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Models in a unit led by the bearer may disregard as many modifiers as they like to their characteristics, rolls and tests, apart from modifiers to saving throws. Only a **TACTICUS** model may take it.

effects.while: the bearer is leading a unit

lastPrinted.note: Build 963, in force at this version's cutoff, no longer prints the Firestorm Assault Force Detachment; this rule is as build 946, the last to print it, gives it.
